title: Quasi-local form for $α$--$z$ Rényi QNEC from fixed-ray escorts
summary: The fixed-ray escort integral representation expresses $α$--$z$ Rényi divergence as an average over ordinary relative entropy of a family of escort states. Working in the standard UV-regulated density-matrix description of QFT subregions, we use this representation to derive an escort-averaged entanglement first law, an escort-averaged representation of the $α$--$z$ information kernel, and an escort-averaged Bekenstein-type bound for ball-shaped regions in conformal field theories.
